description: This file defines a C# interface for a grain in the Orleans distributed application framework, specifying methods related to customer operations.

classes.name: ICustomerGrain
classes.description: An interface representing a customer grain in an Orleans application, providing methods for customer-related actions.

methods.name: IntroduceSelf
methods.description: Asynchronously introduces the customer, returning a string introduction.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets customer details such as customer ID, first name, and last name.

methods.name: AddDevice
methods.description: Associates a device grain with the customer.

methods.name: SetRandomState
methods.description: Sets the grain's state to a random configuration.

calls: Intended to call Task Set(int, string, string)
